verdict.rationale: Choosing a data-storage region is a fair question for a hosted integration and workflow platform like Pipedream, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents region or residency selection. The development/production environment split in Connect is about separating credentials, not choosing where data is stored, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
